memoryMeaning: Fresh Node process, GC before and after identical calls. maxRSS is process peak, retained fields are after-GC process memory; neither isolates all transient allocations.
startupMeaning: importMs includes loading/parsing/JIT entry setup; Startup-phase processWallMs uses zero kernel calls and includes Node process launch, module import and teardown; memory-phase processWallMs additionally includes 10000 kernel calls.
